text:
sam: Heads-up — I'm putting a soft hold on the SDK v3.5 -> runtime 2.15 rollout for hosted-canary. We are seeing regressions on long-sequence, quantized llama3q paths (higher 5xxs / latency tails and a small but measurable drop in exact-match for our regression prompt set). Pinning the runtime to 2.14.3 for the affected model group in hosted-canary while we triage. Notifying infra and SDK owners.

deploybot: action: pin applied
pin_id=pin-3510004321
runtime=2.14.3
models=[llama3q-quant,longseq]
scope=hosted-canary
expires=+6h
(note: use `deploypin` CLI to extend/clear)

anya: what telemetry triggered this? link/summary pls

sam: quick summary: for requests >2048 tokens we saw a spike in 5xx (timeout + kernel-fallback), p95 latency up ~350ms, and a 2.8% drop in exact-match on the longseq regression set. Alerts: https://console.redwood/telemetry/alerts/351000

miguel: is this an SDK tokenization mismatch or runtime kernel change?

jen: reproduced locally — when using the int4/quant path the new runtime kernel chooses a matmul variant that thrashes KV-cache (LRU path), causing cache misses and fallback behavior. Looks like runtime 2.15 added an untested kernel for that path.

sam: plan: keep the pin in place. jen to draft a guard in runtime to prefer the old kernel for quant longseq until we validate. Once we have a fix, roll a canary patch at 10% traffic, watch errors+regression prompts, then unpin. If metrics don't improve, miguel will run the rollback. @miguel can you own rollback runbook? @jen can you own the patch?

miguel: I'll own rollback. Prep checklist for rollback: 1) schedule capacity switch windows 2) disable autoscale briefly to avoid thrash 3) notify customers via status page if rollback >15m 4) get director approval for force rollback

opsbot: rollback playbook snippet:
```
# staged rollback (safe):
deploy rollback runtime 2.14.3 --scope=region:us-west1 --staged=true
# monitor: gpu_util, kernel_errors, request_5xx_rate, exact_match_regressions
# force only with director+oncall approval:
deploy rollback runtime 2.14.3 --scope=global --force
```

jen: opening PR with kernel-path guard and a failing reproduction test. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/1456 ETA ~2h. Will include perf/regression CI.

anya: :thumbsup: For release notes: call out that hosted-canary is pinned to runtime 2.14.3 for llama3q-quant due to a kernel regression affecting long sequences. Mark SDK v3.5 as behind a feature flag for now.

sam: I'll draft the status page blurb and ping product+support. If we can validate a fix within 6h we'll unpin; otherwise escalate to execs and widen the rollback window.

deploybot: reminder: pin expiry is 6h by default. Extend with:
`deploypin extend pin-3510004321 --expires=+24h`

miguel: I'll pre-announce to #eng-oncall before any rollback; aim to schedule in ~30m after decision.

sam: thanks everyone — will update this thread when PR lands or if we need to extend the pin.
